name_reason: Compliant: data_fd2_ prefix, battle-core domain (data_fd2_battle_*), descriptor reflects it is a per-slot frame-counter array. '12slot' is a real domain dimension (12 summon-animation sprite slots), not a Ghidra address residue. No hex address suffix. Name accurately reflects the int[12] array type and its role.
purpose: Per-slot frame counter (int[12]) for the main 12-slot summon-spell animation; tracks each sprite slot's current animation frame (-2..0xB) for the state machine in fd2_tick_summon_spell_main_animation_state.
logic_summary: Sole user fd2_tick_summon_spell_main_animation_state. INIT state (state_code 0) seeds each slot staggered: frame_counter[i] = -2*i (0,-2,..,-22). TICK states {2,5,8}: blit only when 0 <= frame_counter[i] < 0xB (signed compare), then on even frame advance counter; frame 3 signals 'done', frame 0xB triggers color rotation and resets counter to 0. Negative values during ramp-up are intentional (staggered start). All access dword-wide, 4-byte strided, indices bounded by i < 0xc loops.
element_semantics: Each element = one sprite slot's signed animation frame counter. Range walks -2*i (init) up through 0..0xB; entry treated as signed (negative while staggered slot waits to start). 0..0xA = visible blit frames; 0xB triggers wrap (color rotate + reset to 0).
